# Hachimi.ai · 哈基米道长

> Hachimi.ai is a charting tool for fate readers and serious enthusiasts. Enter a birth once and get Zi Wei Dou Shu (Purple Star astrology) and Ba Zi (Four Pillars) charts together.

## Home page

- [Hachimi.ai](https://hachimi.ai/en): When it's a lot, cast a hexagram.
- [Enter a birth once, get both charts](https://hachimi.ai/en#what): One case gives you both Zi Wei Dou Shu and Ba Zi. True solar time is worked out once, so the two charts agree.
- [Client records move with you](https://hachimi.ai/en#what): iPhone and iPad sync through iCloud. On Android, cases are saved with your system backup. Both can export a backup file.
- [Three Zi Wei chart styles, Ba Zi to six pillars](https://hachimi.ai/en#what): Switch between San He, Flying Star and Four Transformations, with fortune layers down to the hour. Beyond the four pillars, Ba Zi has a six-pillar chart with major and annual cycles.
- [One client, one case](https://hachimi.ai/en#case): Zi Wei, Ba Zi and every hexagram you cast for this client sit under one case.
- [Zi Wei Dou Shu](https://hachimi.ai/en#tools): Set star placement to match your school. Paste a star code and your chart matches a colleague's.
- [Ba Zi charting](https://hachimi.ai/en#tools): Clashes, combinations and harms are written out for the natal chart and for the cycles. Take notes on the same page.
- [Case library](https://hachimi.ai/en#tools): Dozens of clients. Filter by group or day master and the one you need is there.
- [Mei Hua Yi Shu casting](https://hachimi.ai/en#tools): Say two numbers to cast a hexagram, and the Master writes a reading.
- [Academy](https://hachimi.ai/en#academy): Need a source for a reading? The classics are in the app, sorted by the five arts, and open offline.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://hachimi.ai/en#faq): How is true solar time worked out? Do I need internet to chart? How do I switch chart styles? What does the Master remember? Do readings need internet?
- [Get the app](https://hachimi.ai/en#download): Install Hachimi.ai and enter your first client.

## Charting rules

- [Charting rules](https://hachimi.ai/en/methodology): How Hachimi.ai charts Zi Wei Dou Shu and Ba Zi: true solar time, calendars, chart styles, Chart Patterns and star schools.

## Support

- [Support](https://hachimi.ai/en/support): Hit a problem, or want to tell us something? Just send an email.
- [Delete your data](https://hachimi.ai/en/data-deletion): Your cases, reading history and the notes the Master keeps stay on your device, and you can delete them in the app.
- [voice@hachimi.ai](mailto:voice@hachimi.ai): Typical response: Within 3 business days

## Get the app

- [Get Hachimi.ai](https://hachimi.ai/get): Download it from the App Store for iPhone and iPad, or from Google Play for Android phones.
- [Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6787621766)
- [Get it on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hachimi.hachimi_app)

## Privacy

Section 1. Where your cases and history are kept of the [Privacy Policy](https://hachimi.ai/en/privacy), last updated 2026-10-01:

Cases, reading history and the notes Hachimi keeps from past questions stay on your device. On iOS they sync to your iCloud; on Android they are saved to your Google Account with your system backup. There is no account to sign up for.
